title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description: You are given an array prices where prices[i] is the price of a given stock on the ith day. You want to maximize your profit by choosing a single day to buy one stock and choosing a different day in the future to sell that stock. Return the maximum profit you can achieve from this transaction, or 0 if you cannot achieve any profit.
hints: The best profit ending today depends on the cheapest price seen so far.
Track the minimum price seen and the best profit in a single pass.
solution_approach: Maintain min_price (cheapest price seen so far) and max_profit. For each price, update min_price, then compute price - min_price and update max_profit. Return max_profit.
common_mistakes: Trying to sell before buying (using a future low to justify a past high).
Not clamping profit to 0 when prices only decrease.
similar_problems: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock II
Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock III

brute_force.description: Try every buy/sell pair and keep the maximum profit.

better.description: One pass keeping the minimum price seen so far; the best profit is the largest price - min_price observed.

optimal.description: The single-pass scan above is optimal: you only ever need the cheapest price seen before the current day, and you can track it in O(1) space.
